_comment: Acts a curate-only key can perform, each with why it is admitted and what a persuaded lane can inflict with it (plans/os-f30ee0d3.md AC5). The reachability drill derives the set from admit.Affordances over the pinned catalog and fails on any verb not listed here, in either direction.

residuals.why_admitted: proposing hypotheses is the curator's job, and the proposal is the one write its grant reaches
residuals.consequence: bounded by the support floor: a proposal cites at least two admitted observations on two distinct non-failed contracts, re-judged from the record, so a persuaded curator can propose only what the trajectories already carry, and a proposal concludes nothing until a lesson PR the governance root reviews lands (next/spec/curation.md)

residuals.why_admitted: contesting is the curator's attributable judgment over held-out evidence, the proposal's own no-fallback row
residuals.consequence: bounded by the held-out rule: a contest cites admitted observations on contracts the applies-when selects and outside the support set, re-judged from the record, so a persuaded curator can close a hypothesis only with evidence the trajectories already carry, and the road out is a new proposal on its own support (next/spec/curation.md)

residuals.why_admitted: any lane may raise blocked(needs-you) per the charter; the curator joined the row with its proposal grant
residuals.consequence: freezes a contract until a human answers: denial of progress, never escalation of authority, attributable and reversible (next/spec/escalation.md)

residuals.why_admitted: standing-only: any enrolled active actor appends it
residuals.consequence: RELAYS text, bounded by the classification lint at 512 bytes per string; the same residual the dispatcher's table names
